name: Duelyst: Legends
description:
About This Game

Duelyst: Legends is a modernized version of the classic tactical CCG from Counterplay Games, reimagined as an offline single-player experience. Play through the game's new campaign to build your collection, or try your luck in challenging game modes such as Gauntlet draft or the Rift roguelike mode.

Features:

  • The original Duelyst experience, fully converted into an offline single-player game. Once the game is downloaded, no Internet connection is needed to play.

  • 1v1 gameplay combining TCG, deckbuilding, and Tactical RPG elements. Draw cards from your deck, place units on the board, and use a variety of strategies to defeat the enemy General.

  • A new campaign mode, Battle for the Monolith, lets you command your chosen faction to victory while unlocking new cards to fine-tune your decks.

  • Take a break from the campaign with alternative game modes: Skirmish, Free Play, Gauntlet draft, and a Rift roguelike mode.

  • Overhauled enemy AI with stronger difficulty progression into late game.

  • Generous reward progression with no monetization of any kind.
short_desc: Duelyst: Legends is a modernized version of the classic tactical CCG from Counterplay Games, reimagined as an offline single-player experience.
